description:
General Information
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
New in the Original Packaging
What is this Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Rear Brake Cylinder Piston & Cup Repair Kit.
This kit will repair both brake cylinders LH & RH.
Suzuki OEM Parts
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Rear Brake Cylinder Piston & Cup Repair Kits
Qty 2 – Caps for Fluid Valves
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
